local users = tool('list_users', {})
local dates = { '2026-06-15', '2026-06-16', '2026-06-17', '2026-06-18', '2026-06-19' }

local function to_min(hhmm)
  local h, m = hhmm:match('(%d+):(%d+)')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function to_iso(date, mins)
  return string.format('%sT%02d:%02d:00Z', date, math.floor(mins / 60), mins % 60)
end

-- fetch availability for all users/dates
local busy = {} -- busy[user_id][date] = list of {s, e} in minutes
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  busy[u.id] = {}
  for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
    local r = tool('get_availability', { user_id = u.id, date = d })
    local intervals = {}
    for _, b in ipairs(r.busy or {}) do
      local s = b.start and to_min(b.start) or 0
      local e = b['end'] and to_min(b['end']) or 24 * 60
      intervals[#intervals + 1] = { s = s, e = e }
    end
    busy[u.id][d] = intervals
  end
end

-- scan days then candidate start times (30-min boundaries, 09:00..16:00, 60-min duration, end <= 17:00)
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  for start = 9 * 60, 16 * 60, 30 do
    local finish = start + 60
    local ok = true
    for _, u in ipairs(users) do
      for _, iv in ipairs(busy[u.id][d]) do
        if iv.s < finish and iv.e > start then ok = false; break end
      end
      if not ok then break end
    end
    if ok then
      return { start = to_iso(d, start), ['end'] = to_iso(d, finish), users_checked = #users }
    end
  end
end

return { error = 'no slot found', users = users, busy = busy }
